name: Add Agent Tools
description: Load operations into this conversation as tools. Use an advertised catalog-listing operation to discover available operations first (for example, list path=v/ops), then call this with the exact paths you need. The result returns a persistent load key; pass that key to context_unload only when you need to remove the tools. Added tools appear on your next turn.

operations.description: Operation paths to add as tools (e.g. ["v/ops/agent/create", "v/ops/grid/run"])
